MicroephysCoordinateSystemDescription: Paxinos and Watson Rat Brain Atlas (7th edition). Origin at bregma for anterior-posterior (AP) and medial-lateral (ML), and at the brain surface for dorsal-ventral (DV). Standard stereotaxic convention: X is anterior-posterior (anterior positive), Y is medial-lateral (right positive), Z is dorsal-ventral (dorsal positive, ventral negative). Coordinates are in millimeters.
MicroephysCoordinateProcessingDescriptio: Electrode positions were registered to the Paxinos and Watson atlas using anatomical landmarks and/or histological verification.
